request.prompt: Design an original premium corporate emblem for Banco Miralmar S.A., a fictional Spanish bank. Merge a simple strong bank colonnade with a single flowing Mediterranean wave into one clever cohesive symbol: a broad navy architectural roof supported by three bold pillars, whose bases integrate with a sweeping turquoise sea wave. The distinctive wave should feel integral to the bank architecture. Convey financial trust, stability and an open horizon. Use deep navy #173D59 and sea turquoise #30AAA5. A compact, confident and balanced silhouette with generous negative space. This is an elegant bank brand mark, not a detailed building illustration. No letters, initials, monograms, text, coins, currency signs, stars, shield, surrounding circle, landscape or separate decorative objects. Must be clear at 24 and 36 pixels.
request.instructions: Create an original, polished corporate brand symbol for the fictional company named in the prompt. Square 512x512 SVG viewBox. Fully transparent canvas: do not draw any background, white rectangle, backdrop or enclosing tile. Center the artwork with approximately 64 units of clear margin on every side. Use a bold recognizable silhouette and generous negative space, designed to remain readable at 32 and 40 pixels on a white invoice dashboard. Use only simple flat filled vector paths and basic geometric shapes; two opaque colors at most. No typography, initials, letters, company name, caption, watermark, raster images, fonts, filters, gradients, shadows or external assets. Make the composition feel like a crafted professional brand logo, not a stock UI icon or an illustration. One cohesive emblem only. Do not imitate an existing company logo.
